title: Sociale ongelijkheid in Nederland, 1996
authors: Gijsberts, M.I.L., Rijksuniversiteit Utrecht * Utrecht, Interuniversitair centrum theorievorming en methodenontwikkeling sociologie, ICS * Utrecht (primary investigator)
contributors: Research School ICS, Afdeling Sociologie, Universiteit van Utrecht (depositor)
descriptions: Attitudes on social inequality and the fairness of income as well as on social-economic characteristics and background. The survey contains the Dutch part of two different international comparative research projects (ISSP and ISJP) on social inequality and economic justice.
